name: Box
description: Connect Claude to your content stored in Box. Enable Claude to search and access files, use AI to query documents, create or update content, extract metadata fields, and more, while enforcing existing Box security and access policies.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Box to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Box to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.box.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Box MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Box lists 20 MCP tools, including who_am_i, search_folders_by_name, list_folder_content_by_folder_id, search_files_keyword, search_files_metadata, ai_qa_single_file, ai_qa_multi_file, ai_qa_hub, ai_extract_freeform, ai_extract_structured, get_file_content, and upload_file.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Box?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Box in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Box requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Box is developed by Box. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
